$schema_note: implementation must be one of: conceptual, computational (implemented in computational experiments), illustrative (implemented only in this website's educational simulator). 'implementationConfirmed: false' shows a verification marker.

nodes.title: Physical environment
nodes.purpose: The true physical state — surface properties, atmospheric constituents, environmental conditions — that the system is trying to retrieve. In current work it is represented by simulated states.

nodes.title: Initial observation
nodes.purpose: A first, low-cost measurement (or a reference observation) that provides an initial constraint on the state.

nodes.title: Feature extraction
nodes.purpose: Transforming raw observations into quantities sensitive to physical parameters, such as band ratios, spectral slopes, polarization degree, or resonant peaks.

nodes.title: Physical state estimation
nodes.purpose: Inverting the forward model to estimate the physical state, for example a posterior distribution over aerosol optical depth and surface albedo.

nodes.title: Uncertainty assessment
nodes.purpose: Quantifying how well the current observations constrain the state: posterior spread, ambiguity between competing solutions, or detection of conditions outside the known set.

nodes.title: Information deficit identification
nodes.purpose: Identifying which parameters or which hypotheses remain unresolved — for example, that aerosol loading and surface brightness are still confounded.

nodes.title: Adaptive measurement selection
nodes.purpose: Choosing the next observation — a band, a modality, or a geometry — that is expected to reduce the identified deficit most per unit of cost, within the remaining budget.

nodes.title: Complementary observation acquisition
nodes.purpose: Acquiring the selected observation. In current work this is a simulated measurement; no physical acquisition hardware exists.

nodes.title: Updated state estimation
nodes.purpose: Combining the new observation with prior information to update the state estimate and its uncertainty.

nodes.title: Final retrieval or continued adaptive observation
nodes.purpose: A stopping rule: report the retrieval when uncertainty falls below a threshold or the budget is exhausted; otherwise return to uncertainty assessment and continue.
